From: Sabrina Vega <sabrina@waveform.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-15 10:12 -0800
Subject: Waveform Analytics — pilot demo timing and finance gating

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We are excited to move the pilot forward but Finance has signaled a temporary spend freeze that the CFO wants to resolve during the last week of November. Separately, our CTO is traveling the week of Nov 24–28 for a customer roadshow and will only be back the first week of December.

That said, the product and ops teams are keen to do a technical walkthrough prior to the CFO decision if possible (short 40–45m session focused on integration touchpoints). If the exec-level signoff needs to wait until December, we can treat that as a separate follow-up.

Can you propose a short-technical slot the week of Nov 24 or an exec-friendly slot the week of Dec 1? We can be flexible with the tech deep-dive — Ben (cc) can host the product side.

Best,
Sabrina
PD: We expect the finance gating call to happen on Nov 30 — that may be the moment the purchase path re-opens.

Attachments: none
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-15 13:04 -08:00
Subject: Re: Waveform Analytics — pilot demo timing and finance gating

Sabrina — thanks for the context and the heads up on the CFO timeline.

We can definitely split this into two events: a compact technical walkthrough for product/engineering this month and an executive briefing post-finance-gate. Proposed options for a 40m tech session:
- Tue Nov 25 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed Nov 26 11:00–11:45 PT

If those don't work, we can also do a recorded deep-dive and a 30m live Q&A for the CTO's convenience. I'm attaching a working mutual action plan (MAP) with suggested milestones so everyone has visibility.

Next steps: aditya, can you confirm SE availability for Wed Nov 26 at 11am PT? rishi, I'll leave the exec briefing calendar to you to tentatively hold the first week of Dec (Dec 3–5) depending on CFO availability.

Thanks,
Hannah

hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
